metadata.remote_scope: non-loopback gateway or MCP HTTP bind plus optional worker fabric execution

applies_when: Gateway bind host is not loopback
MCP HTTP bind host is not loopback
Operator UI is served from a distinct origin
TaskStore-backed worker nodes execute tasks outside the local development process
does_not_apply_when: Gateway and MCP HTTP are bound only to loopback
Worker daemon runs only as a local single-user smoke test
hard_stop_conditions: Authentication is disabled for a non-loopback gateway bind
MCP HTTP is exposed remotely without BOTBOY_MCP_HTTP_TOKEN
Wildcard CORS is configured for a non-loopback bind
Principal or API-key store paths are missing while auth is enabled
Worker nodes accept remote execution without authenticated result reporting and lease recovery

invariants.statement: Remote gateway access is blocked unless auth is enabled and configured with persistent credential stores.
Remote MCP HTTP access is blocked unless a non-empty token is configured.
Remote browser access uses explicit operator/UI origins and never wildcard CORS.
Remote worker execution is enabled only when nodes, queues, heartbeats, leases, retries, and drain paths are observable.

phases.title: Inventory
phases.objective: Record intended remote surfaces, credential stores, operator origins, and worker fabric scope before changing bind addresses.

actions.description: List gateway bind host, MCP HTTP bind host, operator UI origins, and worker execution endpoints from the deployment configuration.
Verify configured principal and API-key store paths resolve to durable storage owned by the BotBoy runtime identity.

phases.title: Secret Preflight
phases.objective: Confirm authentication material is generated, persisted, access-controlled, and rotated through approved secret sources.

actions.description: Confirm BOTBOY_JWT_SECRET or BOTBOY_JWT_SECRET_FILE supplies a stable high-entropy JWT secret with length at least JWTAuth.MIN_SECRET_LEN.
Confirm initial admin access is available through preseeded principals, API keys, or BOTBOY_AUTH_BOOTSTRAP_SECRET.

phases.title: Gateway And CORS Preflight
phases.objective: Enable remote gateway access only when auth, store paths, and explicit CORS origins pass readiness checks.

actions.description: Run the remote readiness command for the production bind host before exposing the listener.
Confirm BOTBOY_CORS_ALLOW_ORIGINS contains only HTTPS operator UI origins and no wildcard entry.

phases.title: MCP Preflight
phases.objective: Expose MCP HTTP remotely only when token auth, tool approval, and bind scope controls are verified.

actions.description: Confirm BOTBOY_MCP_HTTP_TOKEN is set for every non-loopback MCP HTTP bind.
Confirm risky MCP tools require approval before bot initialization.

phases.title: Worker Fabric Preflight
phases.objective: Allow distributed workers only after node registry, queue registry, heartbeat, lease recovery, retry, result, and drain behavior are observable.

actions.description: Confirm each remote worker registers one node, one execution queue, fresh heartbeat state, and declared capabilities.
Confirm expired leases are recoverable and tasks requeue with bounded retry backoff.
Confirm remote workers report results only through authenticated gateway or local TaskStore access controlled by the runtime identity.
actions.inspection: Gateway/API-key auth configuration and worker runtime identity policy

phases.title: Go Live Monitor
phases.objective: Open remote access after all gates pass, then monitor auth failures, CORS denials, MCP denials, worker heartbeats, queue depth, and lease expiry.

actions.description: Start gateway with non-loopback bind only after gate_gateway_cors_ready, gate_mcp_ready, and gate_worker_fabric_ready pass.
Track auth failure rate, rejected CORS origins, MCP token failures, worker heartbeat freshness, queue depth, and expired lease count.

gates.failure_mode: block rollout and keep all binds local
block rollout and revoke bootstrap-only credentials
keep worker fabric local or disabled
execute rollback for the failing surface

pass_criteria: JWT secret source is defined through BOTBOY_JWT_SECRET or BOTBOY_JWT_SECRET_FILE
Principal store path is persistent
API-key store path is persistent
Bootstrap access path is recorded
secrets.fail_action: Do not change bind host away from loopback.

pass_criteria: readiness_check.jwt_secret.status is pass
secret length is at least JWTAuth.MIN_SECRET_LEN
secret source persists across gateway restarts
secrets.fail_action: Generate and store a new stable JWT secret, then rerun readiness.

pass_criteria: readiness_check.bootstrap_principal.status is pass
Initial admin access is available through a preseeded principal, API key, or bootstrap secret
secrets.fail_action: Preseed an admin principal or configure BOTBOY_AUTH_BOOTSTRAP_SECRET before first remote login.

pass_criteria: readiness_check.principal_store.status is pass
Store path is outside ephemeral temp directories
Runtime identity can read and write the store
secrets.fail_action: Set BOTBOY_PRINCIPAL_DB_PATH to durable storage and rerun readiness.

pass_criteria: readiness_check.api_key_store.status is pass
Store path is outside ephemeral temp directories
Runtime identity can read and write the store
secrets.fail_action: Set BOTBOY_AUTH_API_KEY_STORE_PATH to durable storage and rerun readiness.

pass_criteria: readiness_check.insecure_remote_override.status is pass
BOTBOY_ALLOW_INSECURE_REMOTE is unset
BOTBOY_GATEWAY_ALLOW_INSECURE_REMOTE is unset
BOTBOY_MCP_ALLOW_INSECURE_REMOTE is unset
secrets.fail_action: Unset insecure remote override variables before remote rollout.

pass_criteria: Every browser operator UI origin is recorded
Every recorded browser origin uses HTTPS
No origin entry is wildcard
cors.fail_action: Block browser-based remote access until explicit origins are recorded.

pass_criteria: readiness_check.gateway_remote_auth.status is pass
security.enable_auth or BOTBOY_ENABLE_AUTH is true for non-loopback bind
cors.fail_action: Keep gateway bound to loopback until auth is enabled.

pass_criteria: readiness_check.cors_policy.status is pass
BOTBOY_CORS_ALLOW_ORIGINS contains explicit operator/UI origins
BOTBOY_CORS_ALLOW_ORIGINS does not contain wildcard
cors.fail_action: Replace wildcard CORS with explicit origins and rerun readiness.

pass_criteria: Auth failures remain within the deployment alert threshold
No repeated admin principal lockout is observed
cors.fail_action: Rotate exposed credentials and disable remote gateway if failures indicate compromise.

pass_criteria: CORS rejections map to unknown or unauthorized origins
No approved operator UI origin is rejected
cors.fail_action: Fix origin inventory or disable browser remote access until inventory is correct.

pass_criteria: MCP HTTP bind host is loopback or has token auth configured
Remote MCP HTTP exposure is explicitly recorded
mcp.fail_action: Keep MCP HTTP bound to loopback until token auth and approval controls pass.

pass_criteria: readiness_check.mcp_http_token.status is pass
BOTBOY_MCP_HTTP_TOKEN is non-empty for non-loopback MCP HTTP bind
MCP token source is managed as a secret
mcp.fail_action: Set BOTBOY_MCP_HTTP_TOKEN from the approved secret source and restart MCP HTTP.

pass_criteria: Risky scheduling tools require approval before bot initialization
Universal execution tools require approval before bot initialization
mcp.fail_action: Disable remote MCP HTTP and restore tool approval enforcement before retry.

pass_criteria: Token failures remain within the deployment alert threshold
No successful request uses a missing token
mcp.fail_action: Rotate MCP token and restrict MCP HTTP bind to loopback.

pass_criteria: Every remote worker node has node_id, worker_id, queue_name, endpoint, capabilities, and max_concurrency recorded
Every remote worker endpoint uses authenticated transport or local TaskStore access controlled by runtime identity
worker_fabric.fail_action: Disable distributed workers and run local daemon only.

pass_criteria: Each expected worker node is registered once
Each node declares capabilities and max_concurrency
No unknown remote node is active
worker_fabric.fail_action: Drain unknown nodes and block remote task assignment.

pass_criteria: Each registered worker node has one execution queue
Queue names map to the intended worker_id and node_id
Queues for drained nodes do not receive new work
worker_fabric.fail_action: Stop assignment to mismatched queues and rebuild node registration.

pass_criteria: Active remote nodes report healthy heartbeat state
Heartbeat age stays below the configured lease TTL
Draining nodes are visible in summary
worker_fabric.fail_action: Drain stale nodes and stop assigning work to their queues.

pass_criteria: Expired leases are released
Affected tasks return to queued state
Retry backoff is bounded
worker_fabric.fail_action: Disable distributed workers until expired lease recovery passes.

pass_criteria: Operator can mark a node draining
Draining nodes stop receiving new tasks
Drain state is visible in worker_node_summary
worker_fabric.fail_action: Keep remote worker fabric disabled until drain is verified.

pass_criteria: Remote worker result reporting uses authenticated gateway/API-key access or local TaskStore access controlled by runtime identity
Unauthenticated remote result reporting is disabled
Worker identity is included in task attempt evidence
worker_fabric.fail_action: Disable remote result reporting and run local worker daemon only.

pass_criteria: Healthy node count matches expected remote workers
Draining count matches active maintenance events
worker_fabric.fail_action: Drain unhealthy nodes and pause queue assignment for affected queues.

pass_criteria: Expired lease count remains within the deployment alert threshold
Recovered tasks are retried with bounded backoff
worker_fabric.fail_action: Pause distributed workers, recover expired leases, and inspect failing node logs.

triggers: Secret or store readiness fails before first remote bind
actions: Keep gateway bind host at 127.0.0.1
Keep MCP HTTP bind host at 127.0.0.1
Do not issue remote operator or worker credentials
verification: python -m botboy security remote-readiness 127.0.0.1 returns local-only or ready without failed checks

triggers: Bootstrap access remains enabled after admin principal setup
actions: Remove BOTBOY_AUTH_BOOTSTRAP_SECRET from runtime environment
Rotate admin API keys created during bootstrap
Confirm principal store contains intended admin principals
verification: Readiness no longer depends on bootstrap-only access

triggers: CORS wildcard or unauthorized origin is detected
actions: Rebind gateway to 127.0.0.1
Unset BOTBOY_GATEWAY_ALLOW_INSECURE_REMOTE
Rotate affected JWT secret and API keys
Rerun remote-readiness before any remote re-enable
verification: python -m botboy security remote-readiness 0.0.0.0 reports blocked until corrected

actions: Unset all insecure remote override variables
Restart affected gateway and MCP processes
Rerun remote-readiness

triggers: MCP token failures exceed alert threshold
actions: Rebind MCP HTTP to 127.0.0.1
Unset BOTBOY_MCP_ALLOW_INSECURE_REMOTE
Disable remote MCP routing until token and approval checks pass
verification: Remote MCP HTTP connection attempts fail

triggers: Unexpected MCP token failures or successes are observed
actions: Generate a new MCP HTTP token through the approved secret source
Restart MCP HTTP with the new token
Invalidate the exposed token in operator secret records
verification: Requests using the old token are rejected

triggers: Queue assignment targets the wrong node
actions: Mark affected worker nodes draining with TaskStore.drain_worker_node(node_id)
Pause new task assignment to affected queues
Keep completed task artifacts immutable for investigation
Restart only after node registry and heartbeat checks pass
verification: worker_node_summary shows affected nodes as draining
No new tasks are assigned to affected queues

triggers: Worker daemon exits during a running task
Task remains running beyond lease TTL
actions: Run expired lease recovery through TaskStoreWorkerClient.recover_expired_leases
Confirm affected tasks return to queued state with bounded retry backoff
Inspect failing worker logs before re-enabling assignment
verification: Affected tasks are queued or completed

minimum_test_commands: python -m unittest tests.test_remote_readiness tests.test_mcp_security tests.test_worker_daemon tests.test_task_store_queue_leases -v
operator_outputs.release_note: Remote/auth rollout is complete only when every gate decision is continue or operate and no blocker check is failing.
